gap.easy: Write one word in the gap.
gap.std: Write one word in the gap.

wordform.easy: Make a new word from the word in capitals.
wordform.std: Use the word in capitals to make a word that fits the gap.
wordform.ru: Образуй новое слово от слова в рамке.

brackets.easy: Put the word in brackets in the right form.
brackets.std: Put the word in brackets in the correct form.
brackets.ru: Поставь слово из скобок в нужную форму.

reading.easy: Read the text and answer the questions.
reading.std: Read the text and answer the questions.
reading.ru: Прочитай текст и ответь на вопросы.

listening.easy: Read the questions. Then listen. You can listen two times.
listening.std: Read the questions, then play the recording. You can listen twice.
listening.ru: Сначала прочитай вопросы, потом послушай. Запись можно включить два раза.

writing.easy: Write your answer. Write about all the points.
writing.std: Write your answer and cover all the points.
writing.ru: Напиши ответ и расскажи обо всех пунктах.

speaking.easy: Listen to the question. Think, then answer. You can listen to your answer and record it again.
speaking.std: Listen to the question, get ready, then answer. You can play back your answer and record it again.
speaking.ru: Послушай вопрос, подумай и ответь. Свой ответ можно послушать и записать заново.
